question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Policy of racial discrimination
solution:
The correct answer is **'Apartheid'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the words in the options - 
 
 
• **Non-alignment **- lack of alliance or affiliation with other nations or groups, especially politically (एक सीधी रेखा में या सही सापेक्ष स्थिति में व्यवस्थित न होने की अवस्था).
 
• **Apartheid **- a policy or system of segregation or discrimination on the grounds of race (नस्ल के आधार पर अलगाव या भेदभाव की नीति या प्रणाली).
 
• **Commonwealth **- an independent country or community, especially a democratic republic (ब्रिटेन सहित उन देशों का संगठन जो विगत में ब्रिटिश साम्राज्य के अंग थे परंतु अब स्वतंत्र हैं; राष्ट्रमंडल, कॉमनवेल्थ).
 
• **Diplomacy **- the art of dealing with people in a sensitive and tactful way (व्‍यवहार-कुशलता).
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is clear that **apartheid **is the best word to substitute for the given group of words. 
 
• Hence, **option 2 **is the correct answer.
